result.summary: The page is generally polished and functional. The main visual concerns are minor clipping/overflow effects in horizontally scrollable areas and content being obscured near the bottom by the fixed navigation bar.

issues.description: A partially visible category pill appears on the far right after “Healthy,” but only the rounded edge is shown with no readable label. This can look like a broken or accidentally clipped UI element.
issues.suggestion: Either show enough of the next chip to make it recognizable, add a fade/scroll affordance, or adjust spacing so the row ends cleanly.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel under “Fastest near you” cuts off the third card and its restaurant name at the right edge. While this may be intended to indicate horizontal scrolling, the clipped text looks visually awkward.
issues.suggestion: Clip only the card preview image, add a fade gradient, or ensure partial cards do not expose truncated text.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card image is cut off directly behind the fixed bottom navigation area, making the page feel slightly cramped at the bottom.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content so cards can clear the bottom navigation bar when scrolling.
